selection_policy.promotion_gate: Promote only after fixed task-set evaluation, exact route/checkpoint capture, recurring price and license verification, blind rubric scoring, and a comparable holdout retest.
rules: Include all requested model families and specialist tools in the registry, but do not call every entry a general-purpose model.
Only promote a model after a fixed benchmark, exact endpoint/checkpoint capture, recurring cost and privacy review, blind scoring, and holdout retest.
Free-tier access is quota- and terms-dependent; never treat a free tier as unlimited or private by default.
Current ChatGPT session is a baseline, not an API endpoint that repository code can call.
